source: app/domain/policy_engine.py and the four MVP rules in ReturnFlow_MVP_Project_Plan.md
scope: ReturnFlow demo orders only; simulated return requests, no real refunds

clauses.text: The order must have delivered status and a known delivery timestamp before a return can be approved.
A return request must be made within 30 days after delivery. Exactly 30 days is within the window; later is outside it.
An item marked final sale cannot be returned under the MVP policy.
For non-quality return reasons, the item must be unused. If usage is unknown, the service asks before deciding.
Defects, damage, and a wrong item require review by a human support specialist.
A previously returned item cannot receive another return request.
